c74object.name: evi_freqshift_hilbert
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Time-domain Hilbert frequency shifter effect with three simultaneous sidebands outputs
c74object.description:
evi_freqshift_hilbert is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_freqshift_hilbert.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_ssb.genexpr
Like MSP freqshift~ but with a different hilbert filter and additional features, such as anti-aliased saturation. If using in gen~ alone the samplerate must be 48kHz, or if running at a different samplerate the hilbert filter coefficients must be fed in externally. See the evi.freqshift.hilbert~ abstraction for an example. For a frequency shifter that does not require external coefficients see evi_freqshift_weaver.gendsp.

constructor.digest: { arguments={}, inlets={ audio, frequency, frequency, signal } }

geninlet.name: frequency
geninlet.digest: Shift in Hz +/-. float/int/signal. If float/int, frequency shift in Hz +/- 0. (use @freqsmooth attribute to smooth).

geninlet.name: frequency
geninlet.digest: Shift FM in Hz ±. + audio rate FM of freq shift amount ± Hz.

geninlet.name: signal
geninlet.digest: Rate Phase Reset (Naive). Has the same effect (but sample accurate) as sending 'resetphase' to the MSP 'freqshift~' object - it resets the phase of the quadrature oscillators that modulate the sidebands of the incoming signal. Note that in 'evi_freqshift_hilbert' this inlet need not be used, as a major feature of the internal gen~ code is that it does automatic and clickless resetting of phase itself (depending on the @resetauto attribute, which is on by default).

attribute.name: bandsmix
attribute.description: Normalised 0..1, mix the far left outlet between 0 = Upper (or positive) and 1 = Lower (or negative) SideBands. Smoothed by the @smooth attribute.

attribute.name: coef1
attribute.description: Polyphase IIR Halfband Allpass Cascade Coefficient 1

attribute.name: coef2
attribute.description: Polyphase IIR Halfband Allpass Cascade Coefficient 2

attribute.name: coef3
attribute.description: Polyphase IIR Halfband Allpass Cascade Coefficient 3

attribute.name: coef4
attribute.description: Polyphase IIR Halfband Allpass Cascade Coefficient 4

attribute.name: coef5
attribute.description: Polyphase IIR Halfband Allpass Cascade Coefficient 5

attribute.name: coef6
attribute.description: Polyphase IIR Halfband Allpass Cascade Coefficient 6

attribute.name: coef7
attribute.description: Polyphase IIR Halfband Allpass Cascade Coefficient 7

attribute.name: coef8
attribute.description: Polyphase IIR Halfband Allpass Cascade Coefficient 8

attribute.name: drive
attribute.description: If the @saturation attribute is set to on (1), @drive adds gain shaping to the internal sine shaping saturation algorithm. This affects the far left bands mixing outlet but not the separately avilable USB and LSB outlets.

attribute.name: freqsmooth
attribute.description: Smoothing amount in ms for the frequency shifting 2nd inlet. Because FM signal rate control (inlet 3) is merged with the smoothed freq shift amount after this smoothing factor, the smoothing need not be turned off (0) when using audio rate FM if not wished for.

attribute.name: resetauto
attribute.description: Flag 0/1, if set to on (1, default), phase resetting of the internal quadrature oscillators happens automatically and clicklessly. If set to off (0), 'evi_freqshift_hilbert' behaves like MSP 'freqshift~' and requires resetting the phase via inlet 4, which clicks.

attribute.name: saturation
attribute.description: Flag 0/1, turn the internal saturation off (0) or on (1). This saturation is a sine shaping waveshaper that is controlled by the @drive attribute. It is only applied to the far left bands mix outlet.

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Smooth time in ms of the internal parameters. Note that the freq shift (inlet 2) has it's own independent smoothing attribute (@freqsmooth).
